title: Completely ignores basics
body: App asked me what my preferences were. I said pescatarian, and did not select any meat for ingredients I have on hand. App suggests a chicken pasta bake. I could have sworn chickens are not fish.

title: Can’t Use This App
body: I am so disappointed, I just discovered the sorted crew on YouTube and immediately wanted to download the app. After answering the initial first questions, the app freezes and doesn’t continue. I’ve tried deleting it and redownloading, but no luck. Maybe I’ll try again later.

title: Great show, dead app
body: Love the show, thought I would check out the app. It gets stuck with a flipping frying pan waiting for the site to recommend menus. I can’t even get to the sign up page. Boo!

title: Really enjoy these guys
body: I have been binge watching their videos, decided to check out this app sounds like a great idea. I go through the questions and it just sits and thinks and I get nothing.

title: Accidental subscription finally over!
body: I downloaded after it was suggested to me. I accidentally missed the time to cancel and ended up with a years subscription for $50+. Every couple of months I’d look through and never found ANYTHING that looked good. For the most part, too complex recipes involving way too many ingredients that I’ve never even seen. Or at least have never purchased. Or just don’t want. I’m so happy to finally have it over with. In just a month my subscription finally ends. I’m sure that many enjoy these recipes. But none of them are of interest to me. I can go to any recipe site and find a dozen things that I want to make. But these recipes don’t interest me at all.

title: It got stuck.
body: I was putting in information about the kinds of recipes I wanted. Then, when I was selecting the recipes, the app seemed to freeze on one recipe. I was unable to get out or explore the rest of the app.

title: Disappointed
body: I was really excited to try this app, but I expected more. I can forgive the fact that ingredient choices and quantities aren’t optimized for my country. What I can’t forgive is inaccurate equipment lists on most recipes. Also they don’t consider salt, pepper, or water as ingredients, so I feel unprepared whenever they are used. And the timers only go off if I leave the app and come back. Also why is every recipe exactly 2 servings? Who is this app for? This feels like a half finished product. I love the idea, but can’t stand the execution.

title: New update ruined the utility
body: The new update has some serious issues. The app has become so opinionated about how you are supposed to plan and cook. This used to be a great little tool for making a quick shopping list and doing a few meals. Now you have to plan a whole weeks worth of food. And if you don’t make all the recipes by Sunday? Sorry, you’re entire list is gone. I really don’t understand why this was considered an improvement? Why add so much more friction to the users with no real benefit.

title: New updates ruined this app
body: The most recent updates have ruined a really fun, helpful, user-friendly app. I can no longer find any of my previously selected meals packs to be able to go in at any time and try some of the selected recipes. It seems as though now you can only select and use the meals packs within a give week? Disappointed that something that was so good was changed so significantly and is really pushing marketing more than helpful recipes and information.

title: Deceiving and unintuitive
body: The meal planning calendar doesn’t allow you to choose the day to assign meals to. If you change your mind, you can’t change meal packs for the week. The app is barely functional and offers no explanations for anything. Very disappointing from this group.

title: Utterly disappointing and impossible to cancel
body: Don’t bother this is a waste of time irritating as all heck completely disingenuous so angry. Signed up out of curiosity because I adore if they’re YouTube wasn’t thrilled with the pack menu and then made the annoying as all heck attempt to cancel which they make impossible.

title: Not for me. Half the ingredients need to be googled to find in the states.
body: I have had it for about two weeks now(so take my review with a grain of salt) and I have tried to make a few of the recipes. But it’s difficult to translate some of the items into items available in my local store here in the US. Back bacon for example, I’ve googled the heck out of it and shopped around with no luck. And I totally misunderstood what was meant by loose white potatoes(I figured maybe baby Yukon Gold potatoes) and there are many other examples in just the first set of recipes I choose to try to make. It also is not very easy to actually see the actual recipe so I was surprised when you use the potatoes to basically make mashed potatoes(obviously they meant what we call russet potatoes). To me, this app still has a long way to go before it works for most American households.

title: Over engineered, under delivered.
body: I admit I am a USA user… so there are some things I am willing to put up with/deal with myself. What least me to my less stellar review however is the fact that the calendar does not go back more than a week. I use this app for shopping and packs are where it is at, however it defaults (I found it was a setting like 10mins ago sry) to starting each week on a Monday… and I do not do my weekly shop till Thursday. Sometimes I get lazy and let cooking slide a day or 2 which is fine. Except when the weeks don’t match up and my listed pack goes poof because what was “last week” is now 2 weeks ago according to the app. App doesn’t store things you don’t check off that you cooked (also that list infinity scrolls through everything you have cooked multiple times until you realise what it is doing… so frustrating) and there is a way to save things that I would like to cook… but apparently that is a seperate process from selecting a menu/pack whatever. Now I’m hungry on a weeknight and having to scroll through all the salmon recipes on the site to find the one I happened to include from the pack, but didn’t cook THAT dish. Not saving me time or money or saving food waste ( I’m not really a fish person and am not going to use this otherwise).

title: New font awful on phone
body: The new font size needs to either be optional or scale. Not everyone is on an iPad. On my phone, menus overlap and superfluous text takes over the screen. I wish screenshots could be included of how bad it looks. QA really dropped the ball here by not testing this on smaller screens.

title: Crashes
body: Since downloading the app, it crashes every time I tap the search option. I hope it gets fixed before my 30 day free trial because if not, then I’ll have to unsubscribe. Shame as I really like the YT channel.

title: I so badly want to love this, but…
body: I love these guys. They’re great and I watched each video every week. I thought I’d try this app out. While it has some great ideas, it needs LOTS of work to be able to compete with other similar apps that do it much better. It’s pretty user friendly, but still can be hard to find things. The biggest issue between this app and others, it doesn’t give you the option to put dietary issues. I cannot have anything lactose and don’t want any recipes that include it. I tried looking for many ways to find options to show me things without dairy in it, but I could not find anything. And not just for lactose free, if you have any dietary issues, I could not find a way to put so. Unfortunately, there are similar apps that do this far better. And they tend to start with asking about any dietary issues you may have, so it can upload recipe’s immediately for your dietary needs. If they can make this more user friendly and give you options for dietary issues, I may come back and try it again in the future. But for now, this needs some major work.

title: Reinventing the wheel?
body: I loved the app up until this most recent update; it used to be a great way to look for meals by packs to keep down on food waste, and look through recipes. This latest update has made the app unwieldy, and the constant pressure to put a schedule together makes it unfriendly to people such as myself where I might be called in to work at night. It used to be a great repository of fun, cost-cutting, and delicious meals. Now I need to abide by it and its changing systems to even function half as smoothly as it used to

title: Want to like it but app is a bit broken
body: I have been a fan of sorted food for a long time but have also not made a lot of their food. I wanted to try and this new app seemed promising! The food scheduling is super broken- you can put multiple recipes in one day by accident and it just disappears and you cannot change what pack you scheduled for one week. I also think it would be helpful to see what recipes have similar ingredients for yourself so you can sort and make your own “packs” If this gets fixed and the bugs get…. Sorted (pun intended) I might come back and try it. As it stands? Unusable for me and I’ll stick with my nytimes cooking and their cookbook app

title: Bad subscription model
body: With your yearly subscription, you are given one credit per week. If you see multiple meal packs you like… tough cookies. If you are busy or forget to snag your meal pack… tough cookies… your credit is lost. I like the idea, but the way they deal with the credits is pretty unscrupulous.

title: Cant login after sidekick update
body: Great app but since it changed to sidekick i cant login via the app. Username and password work fine on the website. :( Update 20220401 Updated from 1-2 stars for support responsiveness: I was able to work with the support team contacted through the developer website. While they were really responsive they were unable to find a way to restore access to the app with my existing account. I was able to create a new account, but I did lose the recipe packs I previously had and did pay for a month of subscription, which i was unable to utilize the benefits of the app from. If anyone else has this issue my support ticket was 11522. I was also able to restore access through my original email address and provided how to the support staff. Ill look at updating the review again as I use the new app, and if support contacts me again.

title: Recipes inedible. App is a mess
body: Tried the “Hone your skills” pack. Salmon was great. The app is a mess and there’s no iPad version but I was willing to give that a pass if the recipes were good. The second two recipes would be inedible as written. The tomato sauce called for four tablespoons of sugar! I used 2 and it was still way too sweet. Potato salad in the poached eggs were just potatoes covered in mayo.

title: Please implement landscape view
body: I'm sure the app is great, but I didn't really get to try it because I pretty much exclusively use an iPad horizontally in a dock. The app doesn't have a layout for horizontal devices, or for tablets.

title: Celiac Friendly Options
body: I may not be seeing functionality as I’ve not yet committed to subscribing as I try to go through the lay of the land. When looking at gluten free options I’m seeing only a few recipes and the majority have something in common: no meat. I can’t eat gluten but I love my meat (tofu not so much). It’d be nice to know how deep the recipe library goes and if there are tips on how to swap gluten items in a recipe out with something else.

title: Fine but not a great fit for me
body: Downloaded this because I wanted to cook one of the recipes from a video but I think maybe I am not the target audience. I am a fairly seasoned cook and this app felt like it was made for people who are trying to learn the flow of cooking and prepping a meal. I just wanted a basic recipe and didn’t need the Instagram post style recipe or the in-recipe timers. Additionally, it didn’t seem like it was made to switch between recipes - every time I tried to exit the recipe, it would ask me if I had completed it, and other little quirks like that made it harder to work with. Maybe the idea is that all you’ll need is this one recipe for dinner, but that just doesn’t vibe with my cooking style. I think there are things that could work, but I really just had the sense that I am not the ideal user here. Maybe I should have downloaded the cookbook app instead??

title: UI seems broken on 16Pro
body: Love the app, but after I got a new phone the UI doesn’t fit the screen.

title: Can I get help on this?

Is there something im doing wrong and can someone give me steps on what to do for that part because it just won’t work after that for me. I will make a correct review when I can actually use the app

title: Love the idea, many bugs
body: I love the idea and it should make things easier. But every time I try and plan my week it glitches and doesn’t allow me to schedule on the days I want to

title: App is not usable with new iPhone 14 pro max
body: All navigation buttons are at the very top of my screen under the batter indicator and time. I cannot click them and have to exit out of the app every time if I want to go back

title: Not for people with allergies
body: I was looking forward to this. But unfortunately almost all of the recipe packs have at least 1 meal that contains an allergen for someone in my family and there's no way to filter them out like in typical meal prep kits. And the few recipes I could cook were only for 1 or 2 people. So it falls flat for me because the selection is worse than that of a meal kit. I was expecting more selection since the team doesn't need to procure the food too. Maybe it will get better over time but allergen filtering is a must even if it has substitution ideas. Also you can't read the recipe easily before cooking (the first step in cooking) it so I didn't know what to expect from a dish.

title: Not as customizable as you’d think.
body: I tried the app, because I love the ideas and I’d not to have to worry about menus. The thing is, I was hoping (since Barry is allergic to pineapple) that there would be an option to opt out of food that you are allergic to or can’t tolerate. There isn’t and since mine is just a trial (for the month), I’m thinking this is not the app for me. I was hoping to subscribe because the recipes seem really good, but since I have several food allergies it’s just not going to work for someone like me. For example, I’d like to have vegetarian options without eggs (since, yeah allergic) and low carbs. I thought I just would choose the vegan options - but there isn’t one and the and the veggie one included egg as the center. I guess I’m really disappointed because I thought there would be more options for customizing the choices you would have, but there isn’t.

title: App. currently not working
body: Great app when it is working. Sent email for assistance, but expecting a time delay from U.K. to west coast of U.S.

title: Pretty good, worth a try
body: I do enjoy this app, I use it off and on (not just because of its functionality, but because of the recipes themselves). I only have a few gripes: 1. I wish I could disable the automatic timer when going through a recipe step-by-step. I have my own timer I prefer. 2. The text when viewing a recipe in the step-by-step format is small and often requires scrolling. I assume they intend for you to listen to the audio prompts, but I like to listen to other things while I cook. 3. It’s reasonable to be logged in to more than one device at a time, and it’s pretty inconvenient to get logged out of one when I use the other.

title: Calorie counts
body: I love this app and use it basically daily but I always wish I could get a rough calorie count for the recipe so I can better estimate my nutritional intake

title: Cool App, Annoying Pop-up
body: I like the idea and the execution of the service, but holy wow is it annoying to have to decline turning on push notifications *every time* I open the app. I know how to turn on my notifications, so if I wanted them on, I would turn them on. What I want in my life is recipes and recipe ideas, not push notifications. Please stop asking.

title: Almost perfect
body: Enjoyed trying it out for free. Really glad that you can search by diet and add preferences and allergies in. Like that there are quite a few vegan recipes. The only minor issues I had were that it’s obviously geared towards UK users (just involved finding substitutions for certain things on my end) which makes perfect sense and I don’t expect that to change, but also that there isn’t an option for captioning on the end-of-challenge congratulations videos. Definitely a worthwhile app for upping your cooking skills.

title: Loving it but missing some functions
body: We are loving the app so far, specially due to the packages that help us reduce food waste, as well as because it’s helping us use different ingredients. Nevertheless, we are missing being able to schedule more than one recipe per day (ea: for lunch and dinner). We would also love a feature that would roughly give you the nutritional information of each recipe. Otherwise great app!

title: Love it but can we get American measurements pls
body: I have to google u know oz and stuff that my only problem with the app love everything else

title: Really enjoying this app
body: I am really enjoying this app. I am trying and buying new things which is exciting. The recipes are broken down to nice bite sized chunks so it makes it easier. I wish there was a way to comment on the recipe to make suggestions and or possible fixes so dodos like me won’t mess up and burn the leaks. But other than that I think I’m going to continue to use the app as long as I can.

title: Great for making decisions
body: Really helps me out on the weekly grocery shopping and meal planning. Slightly difficult to find certain ingredients here in the US, which means I need to try and work with substitutes. A lot more vegetarian dishes than I expected, but it’s introduced a bunch of healthier meals into my life. Love it, just know it’s more aimed towards a UK audience.

title: Good… better suited for Brits
body: I have tried this app out for a year and while I love this concept, unfortunately I have found it does not meet my needs well enough as an American. I bought this app subscription for the budget and food waste conscious benefits. TLDR: If you don’t have a lot of dietary concerns, this app is a great asset in meal planning/cooking. If you’re an American and don’t have a tight budget/don’t mind searching for less common ingredients, this app may work for you and introduce new recipes/ingredients. Pros: 1) Lots of useful features, and particularly like the one shopping list for all recipe packs. 2) Helpful to have the cooking instructions as you go and timers pop up with instructions. 3) The app has something for every experience level, both newbies and experienced cooks can gain something from this. Cons: 1) Many of the budget or speedy recipes rely on ingredient “hacks” that are simply unavailable or cost-prohibitive in my area (midwest USA). For example, a favorite shortcut ingredient is canned lentils, which I have never been able to find. Some stores will have pre-cooked lentils in a shelf-stable bag, but it will be $3-$4 (where I would expect a can to be about $1), so I end up cooking my own and defeats the speediness.. I’m sure these budget ideas work better for a British audience. 2) I’ve also found other favorite ingredients difficult to locate here, and often only available at high end grocery stores. This adds to my shopping time (having to go to multiple stores) and stretches my budget (commons ingredients for them are uncommon here and more expensive) 3) My standard diet is a lot different than theirs as Brits. This alone is not bad and has exposed me to a lot of different recipes and ingredients I wouldn’t normally try, however so many recipe packs include fish that it’s almost unavoidable. I live nowhere near the sea, so seafood is generally less available, less affordable, and less common to eat here. I’m fine with using the vegetarian options to avoid fish BUT… 4) It’s very difficult to avoid dairy in these recipes (lactose intolerant) and non-dairy substitutions end up costing significantly more. I have noticed a few more options that address this (dairy-free gluten-free packs, vegan packs) but there’s not enough that I would recommend this to someone with dietary issues like me. 5) Food waste issue is not addressed as well for American users, it seems some of our food may come packaged differently/in larger quantity and food may still end up wasted. So overall, I think the app works well and wish it worked better for my needs, however I think it is not as well suited to an American audience. I would definitely recommend to any Brits, and to any Americans who may have less restrictions/different needs than me. I would love to someday see them partner with a few Americans to create a version better suited to our needs to address budget and food waste concerns.

title: Excellent recipes; good app
body: The recipes from sorted are always home runs, but the app is a little buggy.

title: Great app, a few bugs to work out
body: Love this app and cook with it regularly, but am still having some issues with the update for planning/mixing meal packs for the week. Can’t see any dishes I’ve added when I go to the weekly calendar. Really great feature, though, and hoping some updates are in the works to fix those bugs.

title: Great Concept-still kinks to work out
body: I love Sorted food and have been using the Packs, now Sidekick, app for over a year now. It has been a great resource for simplifying my meal prep during the week, as well as for discovering new recipes. I took off a star for usability. The app has always had a tendency to load slowly and some components never seem to work quite right for me. In the past, the built in timers in particular often didn’t work as intended, although I’ve noticed with recent updates those issues seemed to have been resolved. At present, the most recent launch of the weekly planner has yet to work for me. I’ve updated my app to the most recent version and it still does not function properly for me.

title: Great!
body: Saves me time, energy, and money. Measurements are perfect if you live in the US.

title: Absolutely fantastic if you’re not on a specific diet
body: This app is great. It’s clever, easy to use, and offers a good variety of recipes. I was so excited to try it for 30 days. Unfortunately, I’ve been gluten free and low carb for two years and the recipes aren’t really tailored to that. If they come out with a low carb/gluten free meal pack, I would 100% sign up again!

title: Sorted is great!
body: My family are big sortedfood fans, we love the videos and have two of the cookbooks with a third being ordered soon. There are loads of recipes and a lot of variety! So much I’d like to try, but the others in my house are a bit picky. Would love to see some recipes geared toward pleasing pickier eaters without sacrificing flavours for less pickier eaters. Keep up the great work, guys!

title: Love the variety!
body: I’m just trying this out. I like the variety, BUT, sometimes I’m noticing there’s not just one pack I’d want, but instead one recipe from each available pack. How about a “create your own” option, where we can choose 3 recipes from the ones available?

title: Take stress out of grocery store shopping
body: I’ve been using this app for 4 years now. It is so great. My husband and I only have to decide which pack we are getting instead of stressing at the grocery store. We have learned new flavors, techniques, ingredients, and have fun cooking because of it. Highly recommend!

title: This is the best app imho
body: I love this app. Like others I use it almost weekly. It has really helped me make sure I have fresh healthy meals that I can put together pretty quickly after work. My husband takes the leftovers for lunch. It really works to ensure we’re not throwing perfectly good food away

title: Who knew you could fall head over heels for an app?
body: This is the meal planning tool I’ve always wanted! I love to cook new and different food all the time but I’d buy specialty items that were expensive and I’d never use them again. It resulted it wasted food and money. But sidekick is amazing! I really appreciate the focus on sustainable practices and reducing food waste. The app is straight forward and super easy to use. It’s so nice getting to jump back and forth between the full recipe and audible step by step directions with pictures. Additionally, the meal packs feature takes the stress out of planning your weekly grocery shopping and meal prep. And if all that isn’t enough, the food is delicious! I am in love with this app and am really happy to support a team of people who are making such a positive impact. I highly recommend this app for anyone and everyone!

title: A game changer for busy lives
body: I am a single mom and this has been the game changer. It’s a way to provide elevated meals at a reasonable price in a reasonable time. My daughter went from eating cereal for dinner many nights a week to having a home-cooked meal most nights. It’s our time to spend together And enjoy dinner together. I highly recommend this for anybody who wants a app that doesn’t feel like having some complicated routine inserted into their life. This app makes it easy, from cooking to shopping to planning. Every aspect of dinner is covered here. I am so grateful for the time I get to spend with my daughter over a proper meal, and it is all because of this app.

title: Best Learning App!
body: My husband and I were recommended this app by a friend and have used it everyday since!! It does everything from creating the shopping list to setting timers for you!

title: I Use This Every Week
body: I did not anticipate how helpful this app would be. I’ve used this for over a year now and I’m saving substantial money by eliminating unused and leftover ingredients. The recipes are tasty and the step by step instructions make the process very easy. I’ve recommended it to more people than I can remember. One thing that surprised me, being an American, was how much easier it is to use metric measurements. I now find it inconvenient to use imperial. I never want to go back.

title: Amazing well done meal planner lots of delicious never ending recipes!
body: I am a Gluten Free baker that I am bad about cooking at home that I tend to make same meal this app helps me alot about making different meals that is easy and tasty thank you Sorted Sidekick!

title: Weekday Wonders
body: This app has saved me time, money, and in some cases, washing up. I take liberties to use the amazing techniques and ideas here, and use up what I have at home. I add more veggies and less oil, and it’s still absolutely great. I am a better weekday cook because of some ideas I learned here.

title: Awesome App!! But I have a request
body: I have been using this app almost daily and I love it!! My only request would be for items like vegetable measurements. A recipe called for a medium sweet potato. No indication of how much? A medium sweet potato could be subjective. In the end I loved the soup even if there may have been way more potato than called for. Another nice option would be suggested substitutions. Don’t have this?? Maybe use this instead?? All-in-all I love this app. Thanks for your hard work!

title: Flavorful
body: Love all I have chosen so far. Tasty easy to follow and even suggestions if need to substitute an ingredient and twists by others that have done a recipe before me. No leftovers around here-it’s all gone!! Thanks guys.

title: Not for Us Right Now
body: I’ll start by saying I love everyone at Sorted Food and truly enjoy all of their content. We love the concept behind the Sidekick app and the recipes we tried were fantastic! It’s well thought out meal planning with great recipes and instructions that are easy to follow. The biggest issue we ran into really had more to do with our local groceries not being well stocked which meant we had to go to several stores to get all the ingredients or improvise substitutions. We did appreciate the fact that they recently added nutrition information to their recipes, but currently there’s no filter or search option available for those nutrition facts, which would be very helpful for us. There are a lot of great things about the app that we love, it’s just not the best fit for us at this time. We look forward to trying it again in the future!

title: Long time side kick user
body: The app has come along way, over the last 4 years. I’ve originally signed up to expand my culinary awareness and was sick of wasting ingredients. Sidekick definitely fulfilled my criteria. Then I stuck around to see how long the recipes would come around the second time round. Four years later not 100% recycled dishes, but occasionally variations on same theme. Love mystery meals, love the introduction to new ingredients, miss James. Keep up the good work guys!!

title: Left and Came Back
body: I started using Sidekick when I was learning to cook after moving and I loved it! I stopped using it to move to a specific diet and I ended up coming back because I wanted to eat their recipes again. It’s so worth it and so fun!

title: An Excellent Meal Planning Tool
body: I’ve been using the app for a year now. The major benefit I wanted from it was access to the curated Meal Pack shopping lists. By working out three recipes with shared ingredients and telling me exactly how much I’ll need I could tackle my tendency to buy, “just a little extra,” for my planned meals. This let me address my own issues with poor diet, and has been a major tool in my weight loss over the past year. Not the only tool, but an important one. And I’ve managed to sustainably lose over 125 lbs since beginning to use this app. The recipes are generally clearly written, and I find them to be teaching me new techniques, as well as cheats and hacks. I’m glad to keep using this tool and keep losing weight.

title: Helps keep me from going over budget
body: We’ve been on an intense debt repayment journey and I’ve utilized any tools that would help us stick to our budget. I’ve been a fan of sorted food since they’ve started and now as an adult with financial burdens and responsibilities their tips and tricks have been helpful. So naturally I wanted to see how this app would help us out on our financial journey. Tried the thirty day free trial and I noticed how it made budgeting our weekly groceries much easier. Again, I try to use any tools to make this rather tedious debt repayment journey bearable. So I had absolutely no issue making room for my budget for the roughly $60 annual fee. Overall I’d say that it has helped our family save hundreds in groceries since I’ve started using it four months ago. However, like many apps out there; there are some improvements that can be made in the tech side. Once in a while the shopping list would sort of freeze and refuse to generate our new meals for the next week. But it typically would fix itself some time after closing the app. I’m not techy so I don’t get bothered with any of the glitches but I know for some this might be a big deal. I do love that the menus are very simple, quick, cheap yet adventurous. But if you’re not into trying new foods this may not be the app for you. Additionally, for those who doesn’t have the luxury of having international shops nearby it also may not be for you. Overall, I’m so happy with this app and it’s been a vital part of our debt repayment journey!

title: My go-to
body: This app takes a lot of stress out of planning a weekly grocery shop and cook. Having a grocery list to hand is so convenient, as well as having the flexibility to decide which dishes to cook throughout the week. As someone who lives alone, I appreciate that there is usually enough for leftovers as well. It’s also nice to challenge myself - such as when my local shop doesn’t have all the ingredients, to figure out what to substitute in but still keep to the spirit of the recipe. Thanks for such a wonderful app.
This app simplified my grocery shopping, improved the food I eat throughout the week, and has given me joy in the kitchen. Thank you for what you’re doing!!!!

title: Absolutely incredible app!
body: I am a long time fan of the sorted food youtube channel and have known about this app for quite a while. I never chose to try it because I had always felt confident in my own abilities to cook tasty recipes on my own without having to pay a monthly subscription for an extra service. However, a couple of weeks ago I decided to give the app a try as I saw that there was a 30 day free trial and I must say that it has been an impeccable experience! Even as an experienced home cook who is confident cooking any recipe or maybe even coming up with my own recipes from time to time, this app has been super helpful planning my weekly dinners. Instead of going to various blog websites for recipes every week I am able to find all of my recipes in one app! On top of that the app automatically creates a shopping list based on the recipes or recipe pack that you've chosen (with the nice feature of being able to check off ingredients as you buy them). I have found that since using the app I am less stressed thinking about what to cook every week, I have been saving money at the grocery store due to the genius behind the recipe packs, and all of the recipes that I have cooked have been outstanding! I also lastly just wanted to mention how much I appreciate the twisits feature, which allows other users of the app to upload notes about the recipe, including ways to potentially improve it or ingredient substitutions in case you don't have one of the ingredients or you just want to change up the recipe a little. This app is easily a 10/10 and I will definitely be continuing with a subscription once my free trial expires!

title: 5 Stars!!
body: This app has been such a life saver. The recipes are quick, simple and most importantly delicious! I am terrible when it comes to grocery shopping, I spend way too much and end up with food I don’t even know what to do with. This app has made grocery shopping a breeze and lowered my weekly food bill. 100% recommend!

title: Try it; you’ll love it
body: I am totally addicted to this app. I make at least one Recipe Pack a week. The best is that you can arrive at the supermarket without having a clue, select a pack, and come out with all you need for three dinners. There’s a little fiddling with UK to US ingredients, but not much. And watch the YouTube videos; they are

title: This app solves so many problems
body: I’m vegan and I was worried the app wouldn’t give me enough options. It has made my menu easier, my meals more interesting, and the shopping feature means I don’t buy things I’m not going to use. This has dinner and lunch sorted but now I need breakfast too.

title: I love this app!!
body: I love this app!! I have learned so much about cooking and I am trying my foods I never would have gone near before. The instructions are so easy to follow and I love the built in timers. I do wish they had a setting for single person meals. But I can split the recipes in half when I need to. My only real complaint is that the types of chili needed are not always specified. But I 10/10 recommend this app. I’ve told all my friends and family about it.

title: Love the latest home screen update!!!
body: i love this app so much!! i’ve probably been using it for over a year now and it truly has changed my relationship to cooking! i get so overwhelmed with meal planning and grocery shopping and this app makes it so easy, and i have cooked so many amazing meals with it. i am vegetarian and love how the new update makes it so easy to see so many new and interesting vegetarian/vegan packs! i used to have to flick through meat options to find the veggie options, and it’s so exciting to see recommendations based on my preferences! also, i see a lot of people from America criticising the app for not working well for American audiences. i used the app for at least 6 months while living in Australia and have now been using the app for around 6 months since moving to the US (Tennessee). Sometimes there are certain ingredients I could find in Aus that I struggle to find here, but it’s truly not that many at all. I can usually find pretty much all of the ingredients I need at my local, reasonably cheap grocery store. my experience with the app is just as good here as back in Aus!

title: Better than meal kits or delivery
body: We love Sorted Sidekick! This app makes it simple to plan meals once a week, get a grocery list, and have everything on hand for easy, delicious home cooked meals on busy weeknights. When there is a recipe we all love, we often add its ingredients to our pantry staples for a fast weekend lunch or dinner when plans change. The recipes for 2 are very generous, easily feeding 3 if you don’t have the appetite of a 20-something athlete. Tons of options for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and other dietary needs, making it easy to plan a meal for friends who have restricted foods. Cannot say enough good things about this app, or how it has improved my stress level and my wallet.

title: Great dinner options
body: Deciding on a weekly grocery shopping list was always a struggle for my husband and Either we never knew what we wanted to make or were making the same 5 meals week in and week out. Sidekick makes the meal planning so much easier. A variety of options for a weekly menu right at your fingertips. And they’re geared for the busy lifestyle, get a meal on the table in under 30 minutes. It’ll even point out times when you can work on washing up to make clean up a breeze. We love the many one pot cooks.

title: Saved our mid week meals!
body: If you’ve ever been tempted by one of the many meal kit deliveries, try this first! You will not regret it. This app has saved our mid week cooking! We were terrible at meal planning and then the busy week would have us reaching for a frozen pizza or box mac n cheese way more often than we would like. With Sidekick, we now plan one or two meal packs for the week and get everything we need on Saturday. The app even allows you to add groceries to the pre prepared list making it super easy to do our weekly shop. We have loved cooking something new each week and have never been disappointed in a recipe. Being in the US we have had to find a few work around ingredients such as bacon = pancetta or sour cream = crème fraîche and they are not perfect but work pretty well. Truly a fantastic app to help you cook and eat better!

title: Great Kitchen Helper
body: Terrific way to plan meals, and to shop. Explore the app there’s more in it than you think!

title: Great when you have new baby!
body: I love to cook but felt such anxiety trying to get back into the swing of things after having my first child. It seemed overwhelming to think of meal planning, prepping, and cooking meals I was used to that were sometimes longer meals and required a lot of prep. This app helped virtually eliminate my meal planning; it also helped reduce waste and helped me be able to make delicious quick meals for my husband and I. Now I either use the 4 person option or double the portions and my almost 2 year old loves eating these dishes as well! It helped me feel more myself and kept us healthy cooking at home instead of going out and doing take out more often.

title: So many great recipes, with more added all the time!
body: I’ve been using the app for a few months now, and the diversity of cuisine is awesome. I’ve made so many things I had never even tried before, and I’ve barely scratched the surface of all the meal packs. If you haven’t tried it yet, give it a go! It’s free for the first month, so you literally have nothing to lose.

title: This has changed the way we shop and cook.
body: This has been a fantastic tool for us. We’re trying new foods and new flavor combinations all the time. I also hate cooking with imperial measurements now. 🙂

title: Good app overall!
body: The app is solid overall. Good menus and stream lined shopping lists. Only issue I ever have is the instructions are some time vague or done align with my cook times. But that no fault to the app kitchens vary. Fantastic overall though!

title: Better than hello fresh
body: I adore this app. It’s changed my eating so drastically. My partner and I used a lot of meal kits because planning out balanced dinners was time consuming - but those are expensive and feel like fake cooking. This seriously changed our lives. My only suggestion to those in the US: get a cooking scale and be prepared to translate from metric. It’s worth it tho!

title: Does exactly what it says on the tin
body: I’ve been using this app for a year and a half and it has genuinely saved me a lot of money on groceries and made me a better cook. It’s like having a meal kit subscription, but with zero packaging waste and better instructions thanks to the audio guide. There are so many recipes I never get bored, and they’re all easy, delicious, and generously portioned. If you’re not a UK user you have to make slight adjustments to ingredients sometimes and it’s easier to use metric measurements the way the recipes are written, but it is 100% worth it and the learning curve is minimal. Cheers, Sorted!

title: Love it!
body: I have really enjoyed this app and how it has streamlined my cooking. I cook at home a lot more now and don’t have lots of left over ingredients in my fridge. The app does have some bugs, but it hasn’t troubled me too much. One thing I would love to see with this app is the ability to favorite individual recipes in addition to packs and the ability to build your own packs from favorite recipes.

title: Love the variety of flavors
body: I have been using Sidekick for a little over 2 years and have used to make simple versions of dishes from across the globe. I like knowing I have a number of meals planned out as deciding what's for dinner is many times the hardest part.

title: Awesome
body: The recipes are fantastic and quick and have an amazing amount of variety. The lack of food waste is also a huge plus. Keep up the good work!

title: Love this app!
body: I really love this app and the recipes they create. It does exactly what it says it will—reducing food waste by having three great meals that coordinate together. In addition, we love all the recipes we’ve made so far and it’s helped us branch out on what types and flavors of food we’re eating. We love sorted food!

title: Great cooking tutorials and far less waste!
body: I’ve always had trouble cooking from recipes - largely because I’d never bother to make sure I had everything required…and when I did, I’d end up wasting a good portion of it (or not getting around to cooking until it was too late for the ingredients). Sidekick makes it easy to shop for multiple meals, easy to make meals midweek with good instructions, and delish food I never thought I’d be able to make at home. Total game changer!

title: Amazing App
body: This app has opened my eyes to new flavors and food options while keeping my food budget down and eliminating food waste

title: love this app!
body: makes cooking dinner easy and almost fun to have everything planned out. I can’t wait to try more recipes! i’ve done 3 weeks so far (9 meals) and i’ve loved them all. also, my partner and I don’t normally cook together because we can’t figure out how and these recipes make cooking together also easy and fun! loving this app!

title: Great Value, great meals, and you learn some skills
body: I’ve been using the app for over 6 ish months and still love it. I like being able to pick my meals on a weekly basis and the grocery bill has shrunk drastically. One you get your base ingredients, you may only need a few extra ingredients a week. 10/10 highly recommend!

title: 25 year olds that don’t know how to cook that well
body: Look my fiancée and I are 25 and we aren’t very skilled in the kitchen with dishes. I HONESTLY can say that I really love this app. We haven’t used it for long but the dishes are really good and it’s really easy. I have adhd and the way they break the recipes down so it’s manageable is great! I don’t know if I explain more about how I love it.

title: Simplifies cooking AND shopping
body: I just moved in with my boyfriend, and this has made planning meals for two people so much easier. We sit down, choose a pack, and that's three dinners decided. It also caters to all sorts of skill levels, I like fiddling with packs that contain more challenging recipes, but if you are feeling lazy or are a beginner some packs consist of pretty simple and easy recipes. The closest thing to a problem is that, being a UK based app, some ingredients are hard to come by in the USA.

title: Learning to cook!
body: Growing up, I was only taught minimal cooking skills, such as scrambled eggs and heating tortillas on the stove. Packs has taught me (indirectly) how to cook so much more. Learning how to time dishes so they come out together, how to cook with foods is always wonders about (like eggplant), and how to weave washing up into cooking. Overall, it’s made the kitchen a far more pleasant place to be ^_^ I’ve also started incorporating some of the recipes into our staples (my wife is crazy about the potato salad). Over the past year of using packs, our kitchen staples have altered and we’re eating out less and less. I highly recommend trying out Packs - it’s a chance to try out things you’ve never heard of! Or in our case, things we’ve heard of but were too intimidated by (like croque Madame).

title: IM LEARNING!!!!
body: This is the first time I’ve ever felt empowered in the kitchen. Simple but amazing dishes, to challenging skill checking recipes! Cannot recommend this enough! I finally got a second date thanks this! Note: if you’re a bit childish like me, Ben says “whack it” a lot.

title: Great app!
body: I love this app! It really takes the stress out of having to plan out my meals. And every meal is so delicious! My one request would be if we could check off a pack once we have used it. I have so many now I forget sometimes which ones I have done and haven’t done, I want to try them all once before repeating!

title: No more headaches about meal planning.
body: Had the subscription for about 2-3 months now and it has been great. I didn’t like everything I cooked, but the app made it easier for me to do grocery trips and buy food for the week. I live by myself so the ability to reuse produce through different dishes are great. I sometimes will skip weeks because the portion sizes are huge, but overall great app. Really helped keep me accountable and have more home cooked meal. The team was also very responsive to any issues. My app crashed during one of the week and they were able to fix it overnight. Only thing I would suggest would be have more options for dietary preferences or maybe add suggestion if you’re allergic to seafood or don’t like beans. Highly recommend, especially if you love to cook but is super busy and can’t meal plan.

title: Updated after Bug Squashing!
body: Everything’s working great! So happy with SortedFoods and thank you to the team for getting the fix in really quickly. 🧡 Previous review, now obsolete- We’re on the trial period and we were able to access the shopping list and purchase ingredients. Now when we try to open our Pack (Fab 5) it White Screens. Unable to open any screen, including the shopping list. I’ve un/reinstalled and the same happens. I’m on iPhone. Husband tried to open on his Android and it simply crashes when trying to open our Pack. At least I can see it. Been an issue for a few days and I’m at my limit. Having wonderful ingredients I don’t know how to use but are going bad is frustrating. Impatiently waiting ~ a Sorted lover.

title: Saves on your grocery bill
body: Amazing app that delivers. I use to be a subscriber to Hello Fresh and other meal subscription services, but if you can believe it this is so much cheaper and I usually have extras for the work week. Totally recommend and I have actually started eating more vegetarian food because of this app!

title: A subscription that really delivers!
body: The app truly delivers what it says. I am so impressed! Life is busy, and what Meal Packs does is take out the need to meal plan and decide what's for dinner, helping to stop my husband and I from buying out and wasting miscellaneous food in the fridge. Not only that, the recipes are perfect for mid-week cooking, easy and delicious. It's been fun to discover different cuisines I would NEVER have before tried during the week! To anyone who's tried food subscriptions and have given up, I'll just say that I've done a subscription food box before, and to me it's greatest failing had been small portion sizes plus complex recipes compared to a higher cost. In contrast, Meal Packs gives you your list of ingredients for you to shop for what you need and can afford, in addition to a focus on recipes that would be easy after a long day of work. You are given the power of flexibility with this subscription! A couple other things for USA users: 1. Get a scale! Makes it so much easier for Meal Packs and the Cookbooks app. 2. Ingredients can sometimes be hard to find or straight-up different. I just take a best guess and so far it hasn't ruined the recipes! Don't be afraid to substitute items. A final thought, just that the only thing that would make this app even better would be to allow for custom Meal Packs. There are individual recipes that I like the most out of some packs, and I would love to pair them with other recipes I love!

title: Love it!
body: As a full time stay at home mom of toddler twins with a full time work from home job and a husband who travels during the week 75% of the time, this app has been WONDERFUL. I don’t have the time or energy to put into complicated meal planning or cooking, but this has made it so easy for me to change it up and get out of our food rut! My twins are trying all kinds of new flavors and loving it, and we are saving money on groceries and wasting less! I’m excited to try each new recipe, and feel like we’re eating so well for minimal time and effort!

title: Great guys, great food, great app!
body: I’ve subscribed to the app for quite some time now. It’s very well made, and they keep making improvements to it as people make suggestions. It really helps cut down on food waste, and hearing the guys walk you through it almost makes you feel like you’re in the kitchen with them. My wife and I look forward to seeing what comes out on the app each week.

title: Amazing for Vegetarians!
body: I was wondering how many veggie options there would be when I first signed up - there are just as many veggie options as there are meat/fish! That was great to see, because I’m used to veggie options being limited. As someone that lives alone, the option to scale recipes for 2/4 people has been amazing (and I’ve seen a couple 1 person recipes). A few of the recipes have been so delicious I went out and bought the ingredients again to remake that same week. I feel much more confident cooking and being able to prepare a full meal. This has made cooking fun! Thank you Sorted food :)

title: Great food with fewer decisions
body: I’ve been using this app since the start of the year and my wife and I enjoy a good 90% of the recipes we’ve tried. It has been a huge time saver to make one decision on Friday and then get a clear shopping list and know exactly what we’ll have for dinner. This not only helped get us out of a food rut, but it makes shopping much less wasteful. I don’t throw out uneaten veggies anymore because I have a plan for all the fresh food! If you are American and thinking of trying the app, make sure you get a digital scale that reads in grams and be willing to substitute some ingredients that aren’t always easy to find in US grocery stores. I would love to see the app continue to develop and add an option to star our favorite recipes and/or to create custom packs of favorite meals.

title: Best thing ever!!!
body: I’ve only used this for one grocery trip and one dinner and I already never want to live without it!!! I never know what to buy at the grocery store and we end up eating the same thing all the time or getting take out I tried 4 of the at home meal kits. And they’re good but they’re pricey and by the time the produce gets to my house to be unpacked from the box some of it is going off With this I easily made a grocery list and I didn’t have to think about what to make for dinner at all!! It was so easy!!! The recipes are easy to follow. It’s amazing. Only feedback is I wish things were listed in cups more and some veggies I had to Google because I’m in the states and we call things by a different name. But it wasn’t hard to do. Amazing!!! Please take my money and never stop making this product. Omg! Thank you sorted food!!!

title: Best App Ever
body: This app broke us out of our cooking rut, saved us money and helped cut down on our food waste. I’m excited to make midweek dinners again, and looking forward to trying something new each week. I’ve always struggled with making efficient grocery lists and this remedies that completely. I feel like I am learning so much and eating so much better- I was in a cycle of being bored with our regular recipes and then resorting to takeout too frequently. I honestly can’t rave about these packs enough.

title: A must have!
body: I love cooking, but I work full time and I am a full time student as well. I just can’t be bothered most nights to figure out what I’m going to eat or prep for the week. This takes ALL the guesswork out of it. The recipes say they’re for two people, but I can easily eat them for 3 maybe 4 meals. They’re flavorful, easy, and quick. Plus, getting Ben to tell me what to do when I cook is just a dream 😂
I am SO excited to download this app! I hear nothing but great things! Love the Sorted crew, thanks guys!

title: Amazing!
body: Honestly this has been a huge money and time saver! Really felt like I was in a rut cooking the same things over and over and this has really exposed me to new recipes that I either thought was too hard or that I wouldn’t like! All the recipes are easy to do and it is all laid out in a way that makes grocery shopping easy! The app has the occasional buggy issue (freezes sometimes when getting new packs or loading them) but it’s not enough to deter use! I love all the recipes in the app and I hope they add more packs for different occasions! (Maybe add a desert pack or a snack pack - this would really help with meal prep) Only suggestions I would have is to make an iPad/computer version because it’s at times hard to follow the recipes on the small phone screen, it also would be great to have more pictures/videos so that I know what I am making looks similar to what it’s supposed to. Please keep up the great work!

title: Great app!
body: Edit: Thank you developers for your response and the changes you made to the app were great. I have more ideas! Sometimes there’s just one recipe in a pack I don’t fancy; could an option to remove or add a recipe to the pack shopping list be added? Or a way to Choose our favorite recipes and have one shopping list? I’m new to the club and am enjoying the recipes. I made the bell pepper pesto recently and it’s going to become a staple! It is so good! If you’re from the USA like me, get a digital food scale if you don’t have one! They provide some imperial system conversions, but they do not provide measurements in cups. I’ve also noticed a few times that the converted measurements are provided in the initial list of ingredients but not in the actual recipe guide. I think it’d be helpful if there was a drop down recipe list that could be easily accessed without leaving the narration.

title: Infinitely useful
body: Sorted’s Packs app has be so unbelievably useful for weekday cooking for myself and my girlfriend. These folks put together something that everyone can use and the recipes are crazy good.

title: Why I wake up on Friday
body: Every Friday before I crawl out of bed or even put on my glasses I page through the different packs for the week. I’m searching for the key to the next weeks happiness. Bonus overload happens when you go from having just picked out fire recipes to opening it up and hearing Jamie’s voice. I’m sorry he is the best. Barry can compete since he reads with energy in his tone. Every time Mike starts talking I cringe since saying Fahrenheit when you can just say F is apparently a crime. A crime against my ears. One with no punishment to the speaker.

title: Helpful, as in ‘full of help’
body: There are two words that I relate to SortedFood: helpful and thoughtful. No wonder these funny guys created apps in such way. Even a person like yours truly with, ahem, rusty knowledge of technology, can easily navigate through the app. Not once it got frozen. Must belong to club subscription to be able to enjoy this app, though. Content-wise, the app is beyond reproach, with zero waste in mind (should you go with their 3 proposed dishes) and variety of recipes to go along with voiceover from the guys. Simple. Helpful. Friendly. Sorted!

I love it! The recipes are very good, and you can notice the amount of thought that goes into developing each of the recipes. The idea of staples and using the ingredients you buy per week helps cut down on wastage. The ingredients are used creatively so you don’t feel like it’s the same meal three ways. It makes meal prepping and meal decisions very easy for beginners. I appreciate this app. Also, I love the guys in my ear as I cook ;) What could be better?
